text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"thesis plus three reason preview in the introduction","quality":"clear organization","description":"The essay lays out its position and main supporting points early, making the argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"uses Google’s “half a million miles without a crash” and explains what it implies","quality":"evidence use","description":"The essay incorporates source details and connects them to its claims rather than relying only on opinion."},{"evidence":"drunk driver, elderly driver, injured persons examples","quality":"support development","description":"The essay develops its reasons with concrete scenarios that extend the source’s ideas into persuasive support."},{"evidence":"counterpoint framing like “would they bring more harm than help?”","quality":"argumentative framing","description":"The essay explicitly frames the issue as a debate and then answers that challenge with a stance."},{"evidence":"conclusion restating reasons and position","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay closes by summarizing its argument and reinforcing the claim at the end."}]}
